tutorial.title: Get started
tutorial.subtitle: A short walkthrough that helps you go from idea to grocery list without guesswork.

chapters.title: Create your space
chapters.summary: Create an account once so your recipes, products, and weekly plan stay together.
steps: Choose Register if this is your first visit.
Use an email you check and a password you will remember.
Sign in later with your email or username, whichever feels easiest.
After signing in, your own planning dashboard is ready right away.

asset.alt: Landing page with the auth panel
asset.caption: The landing page keeps the first decision simple: sign in or create your own planning space.

chapters.title: Save recipes you want to cook
chapters.summary: Bring an Allerhande recipe into the app so you can read it, plan it, and reuse it later.
steps: Open Recipes.
Paste an Allerhande link for a meal you want to make.
Start the import and keep browsing while the app finishes it.
Open the recipe card to review ingredients, instructions, and planning options.

asset.caption: Recipe details stay in the app, so you do not have to bounce back to the source page.

chapters.title: Keep your usual AH products close
chapters.summary: Build a small catalog of the AH products you actually buy most often.
steps: Open Products.
Paste a product page for an item you buy regularly.
Save it once so the title, price, image, and unit stay available.
The app can then recognize that product when it appears in your grocery list.

asset.caption: Product cards stay compact, so a short or long list remains easy to scan.

chapters.title: Build a realistic week menu
chapters.summary: Shape the week day by day instead of squeezing seven meals into one narrow strip.
steps: Open Week menu.
Pick the recipe that belongs on a specific day.
Set how many people will eat that meal.
Review the week board and adjust until the pace of the week feels right.

asset.caption: The week board keeps each day readable on both large and small screens.

chapters.title: Turn the plan into a grocery list
chapters.summary: Generate one list you can quickly review, copy, and shop from.
steps: Open Grocery list / cart.
Generate the list from the current week menu.
Check which ingredients already match products in your catalog.
Copy the export text when you are ready to shop.

asset.caption: The export panel keeps the ready-to-copy list close to the matched groceries.

chapters.title: Keep import progress in view
chapters.summary: Imports can take a moment, so the app keeps the progress visible without blocking you.
steps: Start a recipe import from the Recipes view.
Watch the status move from queued to processing to finished.
If something fails, the error stays visible in the job card.
When the import succeeds, the recipe is ready in your library.

asset.caption: Recent jobs stay compact while still showing the status and source link.
